newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee falls vs dlr, pound on fx shortage.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee falls vs dlr, pound on fx shortage.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee weakened on the dollar and the pound on Thursday, reflecting a foreign currency shortage in commercial banks, dealers said.
The rupee was quoted at a mean commercial rate of 20.697 to the dollar from 20.659 on Wednesday. Against the pound, the rupee traded at 32.4185 from 32.3490 on Wednesday.
"Several banks are demanding (forex) in the interbank market, and the shortage situation is quite acute at the moment," one dealer said.
